g.text: SAR Cap-DAC Switching Schemes: Why Monotonic Switching Saves Energy

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #333333

g.text: Conventional draws repeated up-then-down charge on every bit trial; monotonic draws charge in down-only steps, reducing cap-DAC switching energy 4.28x at b = 8 (394.7 fJ vs 92.3 fJ).
